description: Spend in USD for the last N days, all keys combined, plus the latest wallet entries. Returns range, spent_usd, billed_calls, free_calls (empty results and refunded calls, not charged), failed_calls (not charged), discount_rate (the price multiplier from this month's top-ups: 1 = no discount, 0.9 = you pay 90%), by_platform (platform, calls, spent_usd, items) and ledger (occurred_at, event_type such as topup / charge / refund / bonus, direction credit or debit, amount_usd, reference = the charge_id of a call). Example: {"days": 7, "ledger_limit": 5}. For the current balance use everyinfra_account; to see whether one call was charged or refunded use everyinfra_requests with its request_id. Needs the account read permission "billing:read" on this key: keys not limited to product lines have the three read permissions by default; for a key limited to product lines, the account owner turns it on in the console (API Keys → permissions). Free.

days.description: Look-back window in days, 1-90, default 30. Use 7 for the last week

ledger_limit.description: How many of the latest wallet entries to include, 1-20, default 10
